title: Native Collective Research Effort to Enhance Wellness (N CREW) Program: Addressing Overdose, Substance Use, Mental Health, and Pain – Native Research Resource Partners
issuing_orgs: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke
National Institute on Minority Health and Health Disparities
National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences
purpose_tldr: Announces Research Opportunity Announcement OTA-26-002, Phase II of the NIH HEAL Initiative's N CREW Program. It solicits applications from Tribes, Native Serving Organizations, and Ally Organizations to serve as Native Research Resource Partners (NRRPs) supporting community-led overdose, substance use, mental health, and pain research projects in Native communities.
eligibility_tldr: Applicants are Tribes, Native Serving Organizations (T/NSOs), and Ally Organizations capable of acting as resource partners across the N CREW Network. NRRP roles include network coordination, training and technical assistance, supporting data initiatives, and program evaluation.
dos: Review the companion ROA OTA-26-001 to understand the linked T/NSO research projects
Attend the informational webinars announced on the N CREW Program website
Email scientific questions to NIDA at the address listed in the notice
Plan partnerships across T/NSOs and Ally Organizations before the July 31, 2026 due date
Demonstrate capacity for network coordination, training, and data-initiative support
donts: Do not apply solely as an individual investigator; this calls for organizational partners
Do not omit the N CREW Network coordination and evaluation roles from the proposal scope
Do not assume webinar attendance is optional information; webinars often clarify scoring expectations
strategic_priorities: Overdose and substance use prevention in Native communities
